title: Spark
lede: E-Club's semester-long startup incubator and pitch competition — for early-stage founders and anyone curious about startups, whatever your experience level.

mission.heading: No application required
mission.body:
Spark is open to everyone, regardless of major, degree program, or experience. At our weekly bootcamps we cover how to come up with a good idea, do customer and market research, and eventually how to pitch.

At the end of the semester, eight finalist teams compete for $10,000 at Demo Day.

items.label: Weekly Bootcamps
items.text: Weekly sessions covering idea generation, customer and market research, and pitching.

items.label: Ideation & User Discovery
items.text: Find a problem worth solving and talk to the people who have it.

items.label: Pitching Fundamentals
items.text: Turn what you have learned into a pitch that lands.

items.label: End-of-Semester Showcase
items.text: Eight finalist teams compete for $10,000 at Demo Day.

items.label: Office Hours for Builders
items.text: Drop-in time with the team while you build.
